editions.brief: Our first edition looks back over the past ten days. Gulf security dominated coverage: a tanker hit by projectiles off Qatar's north coast, US Patriot batteries sent to protect Gulf energy sites, and a US senator saying the Pentagon kept him out of Al Udeid. Israeli papers also covered the World Bank's forecast of a 4.3% contraction across Gulf economies this year.
